scenes.tell: Establish the place and fragile stakes
scenes.show: Wide, slow push between empty trays. Dust, dry stalks, one working growing station in the distance. Wide 35mm; push forward, preserve tray-to-window geography.
missing: New greenhouse wide set; avoid uniform darkness.

scenes.tell: Give the seed a clear physical origin
scenes.show: Close on a nearly empty seed cassette; a small gate unlocks above the familiar tray. Cut before release. 85mm detail; rack focus from empty slots to the remaining seed.
missing: New cassette/gate prop and release animation.

scenes.tell: Establish scarcity and prepare the drop
scenes.show: Transparent reservoir is almost empty. A final bead gathers at the familiar nozzle; no free-floating water. 65mm detail; tilt along the supply pipe to nozzle.
missing: Reservoir and controlled liquid silhouette; connect to existing pipe.

scenes.show: Reuse accepted pilot v5 in full: settling/dent/grains, water on seed/runoff, shell opening, green sprout. Accepted locked macro; preserve all180frames and accepted contact timing.

scenes.tell: A short setback without undoing growth
scenes.show: Closer leaf detail with small natural movement; lamp pulses once then fades. Sprout remains upright, small and alive. 65mm slight lateral slide; near leaf foreground, lamp readable behind.
missing: Lamp prop, restrained leaf action and light-state transition.

scenes.show: A moving warm band of dawn enters through roof glass, reaches the leaves and casts their shadow on soil. Gentle pan follows light to plant; end on a readable lit leaf.
missing: Animated light/window shadow; small material/light test needed.

scenes.show: Pull back from the same tray: all other stations are empty; the green sprout catches sunlight. Dust moves subtly. 35mm slow continuous retreat; keep plant near lower-right third, window opposite.
missing: Wide set reuse fromS01 with dawn state; camera path and gentle dust.

scenes.tell: Finish the story with a held emotional image
scenes.show: Final composed wide: warm window and small living plant. Move for first3s, settle gently; title The Last Seed, then short fade. Locked ending after slow settle; no new object/reveal.
missing: English title overlay, final sound mix and fade.
